regime_context: Detector shows an extremely narrow, one-narrative rotation: 2 of 22 themes eligible, with Coal (rank 1, mean-revert) narrowly leading Banks (rank 2, trend, crowded). Absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so trend discipline provides no drawdown edge here — the tape mean-reverts and whipsaws the gate. Track record (dir_accuracy 0.337) and backtest verdict both say momentum rank is an attention lens, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks' durability (0.78) and breadth (0.944) can convert its crowding_z from a constraint into confirmed leadership versus Coal; the condition that advances the watch is a confirmed handoff where Banks' score closes the 0.065 margin AND breadth expands beyond 0.95 while Coal's breadth drops below 0.5. The condition that retires the watch: Coal re-asserts its rank-1 lead with breadth recovering above 0.6 and Banks' crowding_z stays elevated above 1.5 over the next 10 trading days.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the lone clear leader (rank 1, score 1.095) with the only non-negligible durability read (0.54) among eligible themes and no crowding flag (crowding_z 0.78). But its hurst_tag is 'mean-revert' and breadth is only 0.5, so this is a fragile, shallow leadership — and the absolute-trend gate has no validated edge in this market. I lean overweight only as a continuation follow, not a forecast.
evidence: gate_helps=false — no drawdown edge in this market
theses.dissent: The mean-revert hurst tag plus 50% breadth suggests the Coal move has already largely expressed; in a whipsaw tape the leader can reverse without any trend gate to protect against drawdown.

falsifier.text: Coal's proxy (515220.SS) lags the CSI 300 benchmark over the next 20 trading days, or its rank-1 score falls below Banks' score with a confirmed negative breadth divergence

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only other eligible theme (rank 2) and carry the strongest durability (0.78) and breadth (0.944) — but crowding_z 1.74 flags it as crowded. The detector explicitly says crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade. Since I cannot size (deterministic allocator owns sizing) and the theme is crowded while marginally trailing the leader, I avoid initiating a fresh lean here — the crowding texture argues against adding exposure at this point.
evidence: durability_bar 0.78, breadth 0.944 — strongest trend health in the set
guardrails: crowding is a SIZE-DOWN caution, never a fade
theses.dissent: Banks have the highest durability and near-perfect breadth — the strongest trend structure in the entire set; avoiding it may miss the most robust theme if the narrow rotation broadens.

falsifier.text: Banks' proxy (512800.SS) continues to hold or extend its positive trend relative to Coal over the next 20 trading days without a crowding unwind (crowding_z falling below ~1.0)
